caveats: Review burden is measured in queue entries, not operator time; no user study is performed.
The fixed-budget row for union assumes arbitrary review order; union defines no ranking. Any ranking an operator applies is itself an admission filter.
Six aligned device types only (label_mapping_v16.csv); same scope as Table tab:threelab.

definitions.confirmed: candidates matching a receiver-observed endpoint (per_device.csv 'matched'); traffic agreement, not benignity
definitions.expected_confirmed_at_budget: yield when only 'budget' entries can be reviewed, assuming uniformly random review order within an unranked queue
definitions.extra_reviews_per_extra_confirmed: (N_stage-N_DIB)/(M_stage-M_DIB): marginal review cost of each additional confirmed endpoint a weaker filter recovers
definitions.micro_precision: sum(matched)/sum(candidates) over the six aligned device types
definitions.reviews_per_confirmed: sum(candidates)/sum(matched): queue entries an operator inspects per confirmed endpoint

derivation: aggregation only; no re-run of the admission pipeline
